text2sql.sql: SELECT DISTINCT fn.event_uid FROM f_network fn INNER JOIN (SELECT src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, COUNT(*) as conn_count, MIN(time) as first_time, MAX(time) as last_time, AVG(bytes_out + bytes_in) as avg_bytes FROM f_network WHERE bytes_out + bytes_in < 1000 GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) >= 3600 AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) / COUNT(*) BETWEEN 50 AND 70) beacons ON fn.src_ip = beacons.src_ip AND fn.dst_ip = beacons.dst_ip AND fn.dst_port = beacons.dst_port WHERE fn.bytes_out + fn.bytes_in < 1000

SELECT DISTINCT event_uid
FROM f_network
WHERE (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM f_network AS fn2
  WHERE fn2.src_ip = f_network.src_ip
    AND fn2.dst_ip = f_network.dst_ip
    AND fn2.time >= f_network.time - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND fn2.time <= f_network.time
) >= 50
  AND (bytes_out + bytes_in) < 1024
  AND (
    SELECT MAX(time) - MIN(time)
    FROM f_network AS fn3
    WHERE fn3.src_ip = f_network.src_ip
      AND fn3.dst_ip = f_network.dst_ip
  ) >= INTERVAL '50 minutes'

SELECT event_uid
FROM f_network
WHERE (bytes_in + bytes_out) < 500
  AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND dst_port IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
  AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) >= 3600
  AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) <= 5400
  AND STDDEV_POP(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time)))) BETWEEN 45 AND 75

SELECT event_uid FROM (SELECT event_uid, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, time, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time)))) AS avg_interarrival_sec, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS event_count, MAX(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) - MIN(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) AS duration_sec, SUM(bytes_out + bytes_in) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) AS total_bytes FROM f_network) AS beacons WHERE avg_interarrival_sec BETWEEN 50 AND 70 AND total_bytes < 1000 AND duration_sec BETWEEN 3000 AND 3600 AND event_count >= 50

SELECT event_uid FROM f_network WHERE (src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) IN (SELECT src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port FROM f_network WHERE (bytes_out + bytes_in) < 1000 GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port HAVING COUNT(*) >= 55 AND MAX(time) - MIN(time) >= 3600 AND AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time)))) BETWEEN 50 AND 70)

SELECT event_uid FROM f_network WHERE (src_ip, dst_ip) IN (SELECT src_ip, dst_ip FROM f_network GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip HAVING SUM(COALESCE(bytes_in, 0) + COALESCE(bytes_out, 0)) < 10000 AND (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) BETWEEN 3000 AND 4200 AND COUNT(*) >= 4) ORDER BY event_uid

SELECT event_uid FROM f_network WHERE (src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) IN (SELECT src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port FROM f_network GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 AND MAX(time) - MIN(time) >= 3600 AND AVG(bytes_in + bytes_out) < 1000 AND STDDEV_POP(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time)))) < 10)

WITH ordered_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    time,
    bytes_out,
    bytes_in,
    LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
  FROM f_network
  WHERE bytes_out + bytes_in < 1000
),
inter_arrivals AS (
  SELECT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    time,
    prev_time,
    bytes_out + bytes_in AS total_bytes,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS inter_arrival_seconds
  FROM ordered_events
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
),
regular_beacon_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    inter_arrival_seconds,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) AS event_count,
    MIN(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) AS first_event,
    MAX(time) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port) AS last_event
  FROM inter_arrivals
  WHERE inter_arrival_seconds BETWEEN 50 AND 70
),
sustained_beacons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_uid,
    src_ip,
    dst_ip,
    dst_port,
    event_count,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (last_event - first_event)) / 3600.0 AS duration_hours
  FROM regular_beacon_events
  WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (last_event - first_event)) / 3600.0 >= 0.5
    AND event_count >= 50
)
SELECT event_uid
FROM sustained_beacons
ORDER BY event_uid

SELECT 
  'OAuth consent' AS stage, 
  MIN(time) AS event_time, 
  1 AS stage_order 
FROM f_api 
WHERE api_operation ILIKE '%consent%' OR api_operation ILIKE '%oauth%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'PowerShell execution', 
  MIN(time), 
  2 
FROM f_process 
WHERE image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'C2 beacon', 
  MIN(time), 
  3 
FROM f_network 
WHERE dst_port NOT IN (80, 443, 22, 3389) 
  AND (bytes_out > 0 OR bytes_in > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Lateral connection', 
  MIN(time), 
  4 
FROM f_network 
WHERE src_hostname IS NOT NULL 
  AND src_hostname != dst_ip
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'No-MFA privilege escalation', 
  MIN(time), 
  5 
FROM f_api 
WHERE mfa_present = false 
  AND (api_operation ILIKE '%assume%' OR api_operation ILIKE '%privilege%')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Role assumption', 
  MIN(time), 
  6 
FROM f_api 
WHERE api_operation ILIKE '%assumerole%' OR api_operation ILIKE '%sts%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Data exfiltration', 
  MIN(time), 
  7 
FROM f_network 
WHERE bytes_out > bytes_in
ORDER BY stage_order

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN class_uid IN (3002) THEN 'OAuth consent'
    WHEN image_name LIKE '%powershell%' THEN 'PowerShell execution'
    WHEN service LIKE '%sts%' AND api_operation LIKE '%AssumeRole%' THEN 'Role assumption'
    WHEN mfa_present = false AND service LIKE '%iam%' THEN 'No-MFA privilege escalation'
    WHEN dst_port IN (443, 80) AND bytes_out > bytes_in THEN 'C2 beacon'
    WHEN protocol_name IN ('tcp', 'udp') AND src_ip != dst_ip THEN 'Lateral connection'
    WHEN bytes_out > 1000000 THEN 'Data exfiltration'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END as attack_stage,
  COALESCE(f_auth.time, f_process.time, f_api.time, f_network.time) as event_time,
  COALESCE(f_auth.event_uid, f_process.event_uid, f_api.event_uid, f_network.event_uid) as event_uid
FROM (
  SELECT event_uid, class_uid, time, NULL as service, NULL as api_operation, NULL as mfa_present, NULL as image_name, NULL as src_ip, NULL as dst_ip, NULL as bytes_out, NULL as bytes_in, NULL as protocol_name FROM f_auth
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, class_uid, time, NULL, NULL, NULL, image_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_process
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, class_uid, time, service, api_operation, mfa_present, NULL, src_ip, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_api
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, class_uid, time, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, src_ip, dst_ip, bytes_out, bytes_in, protocol_name FROM f_network
) merged
LEFT JOIN f_auth ON merged.event_uid = f_auth.event_uid
LEFT JOIN f_process ON merged.event_uid = f_process.event_uid
LEFT JOIN f_api ON merged.event_uid = f_api.event_uid
LEFT JOIN f_network ON merged.event_uid = f_network.event_uid
ORDER BY event_time

WITH kill_chain AS (
  SELECT 'OAuth consent' AS stage, time, 1 AS stage_order FROM f_api WHERE api_operation LIKE '%consent%' OR api_operation LIKE '%oauth%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution', time, 2 FROM f_process WHERE image_name LIKE '%powershell%' OR cmd_line LIKE '%powershell%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'C2 beacon', time, 3 FROM f_network WHERE dst_port IN (443, 8080, 4444) AND protocol_name = 'tcp'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'lateral connection', time, 4 FROM f_network WHERE src_hostname != dst_ip
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'no-MFA privilege escalation', time, 5 FROM f_api WHERE mfa_present = false AND api_operation LIKE '%assume%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'role assumption', time, 6 FROM f_api WHERE api_operation LIKE '%AssumeRole%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'data exfiltration', time, 7 FROM f_network WHERE bytes_out > bytes_in
)
SELECT stage, time FROM kill_chain ORDER BY stage_order, time ASC

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(user_uid, actor_user_uid) AS account, src_ip, COALESCE(host, device_hostname, src_hostname, target_host, hostname) AS hostname, instance_uid FROM (SELECT user_uid, actor_user_uid, src_ip, host, device_hostname, src_hostname, target_host, hostname, instance_uid FROM (SELECT user_uid, NULL::STRING AS actor_user_uid, src_ip, NULL::STRING AS host, NULL::STRING AS device_hostname, NULL::STRING AS src_hostname, NULL::STRING AS target_host, NULL::STRING AS hostname, NULL::STRING AS instance_uid FROM f_auth UNION ALL SELECT NULL, actor_user_uid, src_ip, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_api UNION ALL SELECT user_uid, NULL, NULL, host, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_session UNION ALL SELECT NULL, actor_user_uid, NULL, NULL, device_hostname, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_process UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, src_ip, NULL, NULL, src_hostname, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_network UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, src_ip, NULL, NULL, src_hostname, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f_dns UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, ip, NULL, NULL, hostname, NULL, NULL, instance_uid FROM f_asset)) WHERE COALESCE(user_uid, actor_user_uid) IS NOT NULL

WITH user_chain AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_uid FROM f_auth
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT user_uid FROM f_session
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_uid AS user_uid FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_uid AS user_uid FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
),
related_ips_hosts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip AS identifier, 'src_ip' AS id_type FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT target_host, 'target_host' FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain) AND target_host IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT host, 'host' FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain) AND host IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'src_ip' FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT src_ip FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT src_hostname, 'src_hostname' FROM f_network WHERE src_hostname IN (SELECT src_hostname FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL) OR src_ip IN (SELECT src_ip FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, 'device_hostname' FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain) AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'src_ip' FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT user_uid FROM user_chain) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
asset_closure AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hostname AS identifier, 'hostname' AS id_type FROM f_asset WHERE hostname IN (SELECT identifier FROM related_ips_hosts WHERE id_type IN ('device_hostname', 'host', 'src_hostname'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT ip, 'ip' FROM f_asset WHERE ip IN (SELECT identifier FROM related_ips_hosts WHERE id_type = 'src_ip')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT instance_uid, 'instance_uid' FROM f_asset WHERE instance_uid IS NOT NULL AND (ip IN (SELECT identifier FROM related_ips_hosts WHERE id_type = 'src_ip') OR hostname IN (SELECT identifier FROM related_ips_hosts WHERE id_type IN ('device_hostname', 'host', 'src_hostname')))
)
SELECT DISTINCT user_uid AS identifier, 'user_uid' AS id_type FROM user_chain
UNION ALL
SELECT identifier, id_type FROM related_ips_hosts
UNION ALL
SELECT identifier, id_type FROM asset_closure
ORDER BY id_type, identifier
